description: This file contains the implementation of a 'Higher or Lower' game, including game logic, styling, and user interaction functions.

classes.name: Game
classes.description: Represents the game state for the Higher or Lower game, including current and next numbers, guess status, and boundaries.

methods.name: NewGame
methods.description: Creates a new Game instance with a random starting number within the specified range.

methods.name: ValidateGuess
methods.description: Validates that the player's guess is either 'higher' or 'lower'.

methods.name: GetPlayerGuess
methods.description: Prompts the player to make a guess ('higher', 'lower', or 'quit') using an interface.

methods.name: GenerateNextNumber
methods.description: Generates a new random number for the next turn.

methods.name: Play
methods.description: Processes a player's guess, determines if it was correct, and updates game state.

methods.name: GetResult
methods.description: Returns a descriptive string about the latest game outcome.

methods.name: UpdateForNextRound
methods.description: Sets the current number to the last generated next number for the subsequent round.

methods.name: PlayGame
methods.description: Main function to run the game loop with user interaction.
